    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    barrier = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    seeds = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 4]

    for r, c in landings:
